newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rhoex ups 15-mo shr, cautions again.
newsitem.headline: Rhoex ups 15-mo shr, cautions again.

text.p: Results for the 15 months ending December 31, 1996 vs 12 months ended September 30, 1996.

NOTE - Directors said the firm's year-end had been changed from September 30 to December 31. Its accounting policy had also been changed with regard to mining assets and prior year figures have been restated to reflect this.

Directors said they had deferred the declaration of a maiden dividend pending the outcome of developments currently under consideration which have given rise to the further cautionary announcement, plant modifications and stabilisation of increased production levels.
Shareholders were warned to continue to exercise caution in their sharedealings until an announcement was made.
